##### Project general facts

Trussardi Residences is the first-ever branded residential project by the iconic Italian fashion house Trussardi, created through a prestigious collaboration between Trussardi, Luxury Living Group, and MIRA Developments. Located in Al Furjan, Jebel Ali District, Dubai, the development offers a refined collection of one- and two-bedroom apartments that seamlessly combine contemporary architecture with the timeless elegance of Italian design. Every residence reflects Trussardi's heritage of craftsmanship, innovation, and sophisticated living, bringing an authentic luxury lifestyle to one of Dubai's rapidly growing communities.

Designed to deliver an elevated residential experience, Trussardi Residences combines elegant living spaces with a thoughtfully planned community environment. The development offers residents a contemporary lifestyle in a well-connected location, providing convenient access to Dubai's major business districts, retail destinations, and leisure attractions. Every aspect of the project reflects a commitment to quality, comfort, and the refined aesthetic that defines the Trussardi brand.

Each apartment is meticulously finished using high-quality materials and premium contemporary finishes, creating interiors that are both stylish and functional. The residences feature fully equipped kitchens and are furnished with exclusive pieces from the Trussardi Casa collection, designed and manufactured by Luxury Living Group. These bespoke interiors embody the perfect balance of Italian craftsmanship, modern comfort, and timeless elegance, delivering a distinctive turnkey living experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
